motive.zhHans: Amuro 之所以想起 Elena，真正的原因是案件的真相与他过去故意弄伤自己、好去 Elena 工作的诊所的行为如出一辙。Yusaku 自我介绍是这栋房子的主人，并邀请 Amuro 喝茶，因为与上次不同，他的同伴们并没有包围这栋房子。
motive.en: The real reason Amuro had remembered Elena was because the truth of the case resembled his behavior when he'd injure himself intentionally so he could go to the clinic Elena worked at. Yusaku introduces himself as the owner of the house and invites Amuro for tea since, unlike the previous time, his comrades are not surrounding the house.

method.zhHans: 案件结束后，Amuro 用兰的钥匙的复制钥匙进入了工藤家。
method.en: After the case, Amuro enters the Kudo residence using a duplicate of Ran's key.

evidence.zhHans: Yuri Asakura 被揭露是 Gunzo Morooka 与一名一同私奔的女人生下的女儿，而 Fukamichi 并不知道这件事。
evidence.en: Yuri Asakura is revealed to be Gunzo Morooka's daughter that he had with a woman with whom he ran away which Fukamichi didn't knew about.

resolution.zhHans: 犯人是 Atsufumi Fukamachi。Yuri Asakura 被揭露是 Gunzo Morooka 与一名一同私奔的女人生下的女儿，而 Fukamichi 并不知道这件事。Yuri 也成功康复了。Amuro 之所以想起 Elena，真正的原因是案件的真相与他过去故意弄伤自己、好去 Elena 工作的诊所的行为如出一辙。
resolution.en: The culprit is Atsufumi Fukamachi. Yuri Asakura is revealed to be Gunzo Morooka's daughter that he had with a woman with whom he ran away which Fukamichi didn't knew about. Yuri also makes a successful recovery. The real reason Amuro had remembered Elena was because the truth of the case resembled his behavior when he'd injure himself intentionally so he could go to the clinic Elena worked at.
